Everybody ends up in the Brimstone Saloon.
  With all the gold coming through, it seems like the drinks never stop flowing.
It was hard enough getting to Clementine Falls through Rogue Valley even before it turned into a hideout for murderers.
Before he became the wealthy man he is today, a remote bridge over the river was General Diego's favorite smuggling route.

Many brave gun- fighters and cowardly murderers are buried in the Tarnation Cemetery.
  Mr. Black welcomes them all equally.
The ruins of Mission San Meland dominate Sunset Canyon, which leads to the sacred places on the slopes of Bear Mountain.

They say gold makes fools of men.
  The Bear Mountain mine supplied enough gold for an army of fools.
About the only thing worse than being stuck in jail is being stuck in jail in a mine.
General Diego set up his base in an old fort, which had been abandoned after the war ended and before gold was discovered on nearby Bear Mountain.
This abandoned Army outpost has been used as a stopping point for many a traveler, until  Professor Perry and his cursed Carnival showed up.

Tarnation was the odd child of the territory.
  The town fell apart after most of the citizens left, except that strange undertaker, Mr. N. Black.
Little outposts like this crop up all over the West, to the disadvantage of many honest travelers.

Governor Griffon has probably never even seen the roof of his precious mansion before.
  Ironically, it might be the last thing he ever sees.

The inside of the mansion is like a cross between a maze and a museum.
  If you don't know where you're going, you may never be seen again.

Everyone thought the Governor went overboard when he built a mansion fit for European royalty.
  Then again, there's not much for a millionaire to buy out here.
Hell Pass is a place of natural beauty and wonder, and might be renamed something kinder in more peace- ful times.

Some say that wagon drivers were the true heroes of the West.
  They faced more danger and saved more lives that the bravest of sheriffs.
  This route was one of the worst.
Young Nate Harlow built a cabin a ways away from Bear Mountain, partly to get some distance from the Red Wolf tribe after some folks weren't happy about him marrying Falling Star.
When Annie's father passed on, he left her a fine stretch of land near Bear Mountain, along with enough money to build a ranch and fulfill her dream.

A contest filled with blood and bullets on the streets of our fair city.
  It's easy to condemn it, but it's hard not to watch.

This little town has fallen on hard times and is on it's last legs.
  The only thing keeping the town alive is the O'Gradys.

Once upon a time, Widow's Patch had all the right features.
  Nowadays, the few honest folk left, lock their doors at night.

Gold turned this town from a back- water to the capital of an entire territory in the blink of an eye.
  There's plenty of places to spend your money, from the Gun Shop to the Saloon.
